name: What is the process for plumbing rough-in during a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for plumbing rough-in during a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbing rough-in involves installing all water supply lines, drainpipes, and vent pipes before the walls are closed up. This crucial stage establishes the precise locations for your sink, toilet, and shower/tub. During this phase, it's vital to ensure all connections are secure and comply with local building codes. Our experienced plumbers carefully plan the rough-in based on your finalized layout, minimizing potential issues down the line and ensuring smooth installation of fixtures later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbing rough-in involves installing all water supply, drain, and vent pipes before walls are closed, setting fixture locations.
